description: PR limits are disabled so pending updates are never silently queued out of sight.

lockFileMaintenance.description: Renovate's vulnerability alerts only cover direct dependencies, so a daily lock file refresh is what picks up fixes for transitive npm packages.

packageRules.description: Base images are tag-pinned, so digest updates refresh them between tag bumps.
Actions are SHA-pinned, so upgrades arrive as digest updates rather than version bumps.
Toolchain pins split across mise.toml and .tool-versions; keep them in one PR.
Wait for Go updates in go.mod, mise.toml and Dockerfile.
Wait for Node updates in mise.toml, package.json devEngines and Dockerfile.
Wait for pnpm updates in mise.toml, package.json devEngines and Dockerfile.
Keep the goose library in go.mod and the goose CLI in mise.toml on one version, so the CLI that creates and rolls back migrations matches the library that applies them.

Review aid only, not a sync guarantee. mise.toml's go-test-coverage pin must match the version embedded in the go-covergrid action. No minimumGroupSize: it would hold a go-covergrid update back whenever the mise pin is already current.
prBodyNotes: Renovate cannot see the go-test-coverage version embedded in the go-covergrid action, so nothing in this PR guarantees mise.toml and CI agree.
